how.title: Guidew Journey
how.heading: How Guidew Works
how.subtitle: From onboarding to in-person experiences, Guidew keeps every step transparent and safe for travelers and providers.

steps.title: Create & Explore
steps.description: Sign up in seconds and browse by city, map, or curated themes.
steps.detailBody: Set your language preference, choose traveler or provider mode, and use map view, curated collections, and saved filters to build a shortlist of experts.
bullets: Map view for nearby experts, list view for global browsing
Save favorites and enable alerts for new services

steps.title: Tell Us Your Need
steps.description: Describe the request, time, and meeting spot.
steps.detailTitle: 2. Share what you need in plain language
steps.detailBody: Set service type, time window, duration, and location. Use the AI request field for complex itineraries—Guidew structures everything for you.
bullets: Choose preset tags like dance, translation, or emergency help
Add multiple time slots and backup locations
Upload screenshots or references for personalized prep

steps.title: Match & Chat
steps.detailBody: Experts are ranked by proximity, availability, VIP status, and reviews. Chat in-app, request AI-generated itineraries, and confirm add-ons before booking.
bullets: AI itinerary drafts that both sides can edit

steps.title: Confirm & Pay
steps.detailTitle: 4. Confirm instantly, funds stay in escrow
steps.detailBody: Authorize payment via Stripe (Apple Pay/Google Pay coming soon). Funds remain in escrow until you mark the experience complete.
bullets: VIP users pay zero hiring fees with priority routing

steps.title: Experience
steps.description: Meet your expert and enjoy local magic.
steps.detailBody: Get navigation tips, share live location, and access emergency contacts. Afterward, tip, review, or extend the booking with one tap.
bullets: Mutual reviews unlock badges and perks

safety.title: Verified Identities
safety.description: Tiered verification for every service level.
safety.detailBody: From ID and liveness checks to professional certificates and criminal records, every sensitive service category requires extra documentation.
bullets: Upload professional certificates or government permits
In-home or childcare services require background checks

safety.title: Protected Payments
safety.detailBody: Guidew charges a flat 15% commission. Funds sit in escrow until both sides confirm completion. VIP users enjoy zero hiring fees and dedicated support.
bullets: VIP = zero hiring fees + priority routing
Support for tips, partial refunds, and add-ons

safety.title: Mutual Reviews
safety.detailBody: Reviews stay private until both parties submit or seven days pass. If issues occur, our team references chats, locations, and itineraries to arbitrate.
bullets: Reviews hidden until both sides submit
One-tap dispute submission with evidence upload

how.providerSubtitle: Build a trustworthy storefront and manage orders with confidence

provider.title: Provider App
provider.detailBody: Access the live request board, order list, chat, and wallet in one app. VIP providers can enable auto-accept and define their max travel radius.
bullets: Filter orders by region or service type

provider.title: Showcase Skills
provider.detailBody: Upload intro videos, audio intros, certificates, and photos. Add service tags, min hours, included expenses, and language abilities.
bullets: Support for multilingual bios and audio greetings

provider.title: Order Execution
provider.description: Communicate, use AI itineraries, deliver results.
provider.detailBody: Chat to align details, use AI to draft itineraries, submit deliverables, and release funds once the client confirms.
bullets: Wallet view shows payable vs. pending balances

become.processSubtitle: Every step is guided by an onboarding specialist

processSteps.title: Identity & background
processSteps.description: Upload ID, selfie, and essential certificates.
processSteps.detailBody: Provide a government ID, complete liveness verification, and upload relevant certificates or licenses. In-home and childcare services require an additional background check.
bullets: High-trust services require criminal record checks

processSteps.title: Service storefront
processSteps.description: Record introductions, set pricing, define scope.
processSteps.detailBody: Add intro videos, testimonials, and service tags. Define what is included, travel radius, minimum hours, and languages you support.
bullets: AI can refine your self-introduction copy

processSteps.title: Operational training
processSteps.description: Learn the live request board and AI itinerary tools.
processSteps.detailTitle: 3. Train on the live request board
processSteps.detailBody: Understand how instant requests appear, how auto-accept works for VIP, and how to communicate with travelers using templates and AI itineraries.
bullets: AI itinerary builder with editable blocks

processSteps.title: Launch & scale
processSteps.description: Go live, request reviews, earn achievements.
processSteps.detailBody: Start taking orders, collect mutual reviews, and unlock VIP perks such as automatic acceptance and personalized growth coaching.
bullets: VIP providers get AI-generated marketing kits
Quarterly workshops to master pricing and upsells

benefits.title: Real customers daily

benefits.title: Human + AI support
benefits.description: Onboarding specialists and AI assistants help you polish your storefront, write proposals, and manage paperwork.
